object.description: Run Export with a PDF program that fails with the message 'tectonic exploded', and with an output folder that doesn't exist; call the export tool with a PDF program that isn't found. Expected: the Document Editor shows an error message holding the PDF program's reason, or that the file couldn't be written, with 'Export failed.' in the status bar and no file written; the export tool returns an error result, not an exception, naming the PDF program.
